variants.name: 750 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Seed, grain and nut mix for parrots, rich in nuts in the shell, with banana and unpeeled peanuts, supplemented with chilli peppers
  • 15% nuts in shell (6 types)
  • With banana
  • No colourants
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: striped sunflower seeds, white sunflower seeds, safflower, topped oats, puffed wheat, dehulled oats, buckwheat, milo, puffed maize, peanut, banana, barley, almond, walnut, hazelnut, pine nut, pumpkin seeds, raisins, maize, pecan, papaya, chilli pepper, decorticated Brazil nut, coconut flakes.

Analytical constituents: protein 12.0%, fat content 22.2%, crude fibre 15.7%, crude ash 2.7%, calcium 0.13%, phosphorus 0.31%.
variants.feeding_instructions: Can be used as a main feed or as a healthy treat. When fed as the main feed, supplement regularly with vitamins, amino acids, trace elements and a source of calcium; up to 20% of the daily ration can be fruit and vegetables. Provide freely, change the feed regularly and always provide fresh drinking water.
